name: ui-ux-designer
description: Senior UI/UX designer skill. Turns a brief, backlog, module or redesign request into a justified, accessible, mobile-first Interface & Journey Guide: design system, three-layer tokens, screen-by-screen specs, nine states, motion, UX copy, data-viz, WCAG 2.1 AA. Derives the art direction from the subject (or a palette you give); never writes code and never chooses the tech stack. Use when designing or auditing UI/UX, a screen or component, a design system, or a user flow.
